title: crypto2dev: ECDH key agreement callback
description: Implement CryptoCb handler for ECDH (Curve/ECDH P-256/P-384) via DO_AGREE ioctl. Retrieve local KEY fd from key->devCtx, call DO_AGREE with peer's uncompressed public key point, salt, and info for embedded HKDF. The raw shared secret Z never leaves the kernel — DO_AGREE runs HKDF internally and returns derived key material (OKM). Map wolfSSL wc_CryptoCb_Ecdh() callback fields to DO_AGREE struct fields. Note: wolfSSL callers that expect raw Z (not HKDF output) cannot use this path — return CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE for those.
notes: DO_AGREE performs ECDH+HKDF atomically. wolfSSL's Curve25519 (X25519) callback receives a peer key and expects raw shared secret — not HKDF output — so return CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE for Curve25519 and let software handle it. Only wire up the ECC ECDH path where the TLS layer will call HKDF on top anyway.
